purpose: Extend the JANUS/TOPA UAP x nuclear branch using current internal lineage plus fresh open-access primary, official, peer-reviewed and public-dataset sources, while turning the branch into a concrete sequence of falsifiable experiments.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: NARA states RG 615 is a rolling UAP collection created under the FY2024 NDAA. As of the page reviewed 2026-09-21, listed series include NRC, FAA, ODNI, OSD, NSA, State, FBI, Air Force and CBP.
fresh_open_access_updates.new_value: The NRC series (NARA ID 488808322) is a machine-discovery target for building a primary-source nuclear-site event ledger rather than relying on anecdotal case lists.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: PURSUE currently indexes five DOE UAP-related records, including DOE-UAP-D004 Los Alamos Conference on Aerial Phenomena (1949) and DOE-UAP-D005 Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report (2015). The release page explicitly says unresolved status can reflect insufficient data and does not itself establish origin.
fresh_open_access_updates.new_value: These are suitable for source-bound case forensics, not for population-rate inference by themselves.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: The released report describes Ground Surveillance Radar detection of an unknown slow-moving object on 2015-09-01, Protective Force ground confirmation and pursuit, multiple visual descriptions, GSR imagery and later Sandia image enhancement. The report states the object was non-threatening and remained over open/unpopulated areas before proceeding offsite.
measured_or_reported_features: reported altitude approximately 100-200 ft in one witness account
reported size approximately 4 ft tall x 2 ft wide in one account
fresh_open_access_updates.next_gate: Bind radar/video/image provenance, timestamp geometry, weather/wind, balloon/UAS hypotheses and witness disagreement before any anomaly score.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: NRC states regulations were updated in 2024 to require nuclear power plant licensees to report drone sightings; reports are sent to NRC, FAA, FBI and local law enforcement.
fresh_open_access_updates.importance: A reporting mandate is a direct denominator/pipeline change and can create apparent rate increases even if underlying physical activity does not change.

fresh_open_access_updates.source: AARO FY2025 Consolidated Annual Report, 26-P-0880, official AARO release 2026-07-20
fresh_open_access_updates.interpretation: A large modern nuclear-site aerial-activity baseline can exist while reporting authorities classify those events as UAS, not UAP. The 18->50 comparison is not a clean physical-rate trend because the NRC reporting regime changed in 2024.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: NASA emphasizes calibrated sensors, metadata, multiple sensors and the fact that some apparent UAP become sensor artifacts after calibration/metadata scrutiny.
fresh_open_access_updates.TOPA_translation: Every detector branch must carry a Representation Contract: what the sensor preserves, what artifacts it can create, and what independent witness can falsify a detector-internal explanation.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: A Bayesian analysis of more than 98,000 public UAP reports found credible spatial relationships consistent with opportunity-to-see and human-made airborne activity; air traffic and military activity were important contextual variables.
fresh_open_access_updates.TOPA_translation: Population, visibility, internet/reporting access, air traffic and military activity are mandatory covariates for any spatial nuclear-site comparison.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: The 2025 paper reports a positive nuclear-test/transient association; the 2026 critique argues observation schedule and image/data-definition issues remove or weaken the signal; the original authors dispute parts of that critique.
fresh_open_access_updates.TOPA_translation: Do not choose a side by citation. Reproduce the old endpoint, then apply observation-opportunity and image-quality controls prospectively.

fresh_open_access_updates.observed: The public package contains a report and spreadsheet built from 590 selected UAP reports from 1945-1975 and compares atomic production/assembly/stockpile/deployment sites with civilian and non-atomic military controls.
fresh_open_access_updates.TOPA_translation: High-value reanalysis target, but raw incident counts cannot be treated as rates until site-time observation/reporting opportunity is reconstructed.

PALOMAR_JPFM_2E.result: In the JANUS open dense S0 cohort, binary ANY_CANDIDATE is identical to Palomar observed-night availability; conditional candidate-rate models do not show a robust positive nuclear enhancement.

BLUE_BOOK_EXACT_DATE.result: No positive STARLIKE nuclear specificity in the reconstructed public Blue Book layer; strong non-nuclear baseline retained.

new_hidden_machine.name: REPORTING_PIPELINE_MACHINE
new_hidden_machine.why_it_matters: The 2024 NRC reporting requirement demonstrates a real intervention on the pipeline. A count jump after that point can be caused by reporting policy, physical event rate, or both.

experiment_ladder.name: NRC_RG615_PRIMARY_LEDGER
experiment_ladder.goal: Ingest NRC RG615 metadata/records into a deduplicated event ledger with event date, site, detector, reporting authority, stated classification, resolution status and source hash.
experiment_ladder.deliverable: Primary-source event table plus explicit NO_RECORD != NO_EVENT firewall.

experiment_ladder.name: MODERN_POLICY_NORMALIZED_UAS_BASELINE
experiment_ladder.goal: Estimate a modern nuclear-site aerial-incursion baseline while treating the 2024 NRC reporting requirement as a reporting-process changepoint.
experiment_ladder.killer_question: Does the FY24->FY25 increase survive a reporting-policy-aware denominator?

experiment_ladder.name: PANTEX_MULTI_SENSOR_FORENSICS
experiment_ladder.goal: Treat radar, visual witnesses and imagery as separate witnesses; test balloon/UAS/drift/geometry hypotheses before any extraordinary classification.
experiment_ladder.success: A source-bounded causal ranking with disagreement preserved.
experiment_ladder.failure: Insufficient metadata remains an allowed terminal state.

experiment_ladder.name: SCU_590_DENOMINATOR_REANALYSIS
experiment_ladder.goal: Reanalyze atomic versus control sites with explicit site-time denominators, population, military activity, reporting intensity and archival completeness.
experiment_ladder.primary_endpoint: rate ratio or model coefficient for atomic-site class after matched/confound controls
experiment_ladder.hard_rule: Selected historical case counts alone cannot define incidence.

experiment_ladder.name: JANUS_UAP_NUCLEAR_BRANCHING_REANALYSIS_01
experiment_ladder.goal: Recover and reproduce the historical positive Palomar result first, then apply schedule normalization, plate/image controls, pseudo-event nulls and independent human-report controls without tuning to the outcome.

experiment_ladder.name: CROSS_CHANNEL_RESIDUAL_TRIANGULATION
experiment_ladder.goal: Ask whether a residual nuclear-context signal survives independently in photographic, human-report and security/UAS channels after each channel's own denominator and detector contract.
experiment_ladder.admission_rule: No pooled extraordinary claim unless at least two independent channels survive their own preregistered nulls and share a prospectively defined timing/spatial feature.

what_we_get_if_this_branch_works.minimum_success: A clean map of which nuclear-UAP claims are archival facts, which are reporting-pipeline effects, which are unresolved case studies, and which survive controlled statistics.
what_we_get_if_this_branch_works.medium_success: A reproducible residual-association estimate after denominator, sensor, policy, military-activity and reporting-opportunity controls.
what_we_get_if_this_branch_works.strong_success: Independent residual signals in at least two separately measured channels with prospectively frozen spatial/temporal structure.
what_we_get_if_this_branch_works.true_next_scientific_gain: If a residual survives, the branch transitions from folklore/correlation audit to mechanism discrimination: what physical or reporting process could generate the shared residual and what new observation would distinguish competing models?

current_branch_verdict: THE_FIELD_CONTAINS_REAL_PRIMARY_RECORDS_AND_REAL_STATISTICAL_CLAIMS, BUT ALSO REAL_REPORTING_AND_OBSERVATION_CONFOUNDS. THE MOST VALUABLE NEXT MOVE IS NOT MORE ANECDOTES; IT IS PRIMARY-LEDGER INGESTION PLUS POLICY/DENOMINATOR-NORMALIZED REANALYSIS.
canonical_seal: DON'T COUNT THE ARCHIVE AS IF IT WERE THE SKY. MODEL THE DETECTOR, THE REPORTING RULE, THE DENOMINATOR, AND THE NULL. THEN ASK WHAT IS LEFT.
